about.title: Much more than a salon, a care center
about.text: HairSpa Dakar is not a traditional hair salon, but a true hair care and education center. Our goal: to educate, motivate, and support clients in achieving healthy, long, and voluminous hair, regardless of origin or hair texture.
about.founder: Founded in 2017 by Marpessa, the center offers a personalized approach to every hair routine.
